learning_outcomes.text: Solves differential equations using Laplace transforms.
Derives mathematical models of various physical systems.
Creates the transfer function and block diagram of a physical system.
Knows the operating principles of control elements.
Interprets the stability of a control system using stability criteria.

syllabus_topics: Introduction and basic concepts; Unit Systems
Laplace Transforms, Direct Laplace Operations; Laplace Transform
Inverse Laplace Transform; Inverse Laplace Transform
Transfer Functions, Solution of Linear Differential Equations using Laplace Transform
Derivation of Mathematical Models of Various Physical Systems; Newton's Laws of Motion
Derivation of Mathematical Models of Various Physical Systems; Newton's Laws of Motion
